metaTitle: Custom Cotton Poly Headbands & Wristbands | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom cotton poly headbands and wristbands in bulk. Ideal for events, teams, and giveaways. Fast turnaround at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Cotton poly headbands and wristbands combine the softness of cotton with the durability of polyester, making them a practical choice for events, sports teams, and corporate giveaways. The blend resists shrinking and fading, so your logo stays vibrant through repeated wear and washing. Whether you need sweat-wicking wristbands for a 5K or comfortable headbands for a company picnic, this fabric blend delivers long-lasting comfort and brand visibility. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery for a custom look that stands out.
heroAltText: Custom cotton poly headbands and wristbands in assorted colors with printed logos
